title: Public Domain Image Archive
summary: Public Domain Image Archive is a website that provides a collection of public domain images that users can freely download and use without copyright restrictions. The site was shared on Hacker News and received positive community engagement with 126 points.
problem_solved: Provides creators, designers, and developers with free, legally-usable public domain images for their projects.
why_valuable: Offers a curated archive of copyright-free images that eliminates legal concerns and licensing costs for commercial and personal use.
